Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray steps down due to health issues
Mowbray confirms he has had to ‘step back from my role’
Rovers are currently 13th in the Championship table
The Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray has stood down from his role due to illness.
“Unfortunately, due to health issues, I have to step back from my role,” said Mowbray, whose team are 13th in the Championship. “I’m immensely proud of this group of players. Their dedication and professionalism have given us some memorable performances and wins, and I’ve loved working with them.
“Thank you to my coaching staff for all your hard work and for the support you’ve given me. It’s been a pleasure working alongside you. To the fans, thank you for the way you’ve supported me and the team this season. I’ve always tried to give you a team that you can be proud of. Your support has meant a great deal to me. I’m grateful to the owners and Suhail for giving me the opportunity to lead this great club once again. I’d ask that you give me and my family privacy at this time.”
